description: Granblue Fantasy Side Story Farming Decision Engine & Spark Velocity Accelerator.

decisionTiers.title: Tier 0: Pivotal Account Foundation & 1-Click Spark Fuel
decisionTiers.rationale: High-priority instant unlocks providing core account foundation: Bahamut Nova Skill 10, Atma Skill 10, free top-tier SSRs, and immediate 3x Premium Draw Tickets per story.

decisionTiers.title: Tier 1: Elemental Roster Coverage & Team Synergies
decisionTiers.rationale: Unlocks full 3-unit trios in all 6 elements without spending gacha crystals, along with powerful sub-auras and offensive utilities.

decisionTiers.title: Tier 2: Consumable Arbitrage & AP/EP Stockpiling
decisionTiers.rationale: Farming 100x Half-Elixirs (200 AP net positive per story) and 500x Soul Berries to maintain infinite raid leeching and gold bar racing stamina.

decisionTiers.title: Tier 3: Lore Completion, Trophies & Weapon Skins
decisionTiers.rationale: Background clearing of early classic events for trophy crystals, weapon skin unlocks, and legacy lore completion.

speedClearingPacing.storySkipPolicy: Immediately invoke in-game 'Skip' button on all story episodes to collect crystals and recruit characters without viewing animation, saving ~15 minutes per side story.

keySkillsOrSummons: Kaguya / White Rabbit helper summon for drop boost
